comment: The module declares one output in its enum but the widget adds no port for it, so it has no jack and no census position and gets no line. The invert jack's gate mode fires on both edges of the gate: each change of level asks Merc8or to toggle, so the range is inverted while the gate is high and back again when it falls. Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so nothing here is polyphonic even though Merc8or itself is.
